turns.content: okay so funny story lol. yesterday was my birthday. you know what time my boyfriend of THREE years wished me? 11:48 pm. "happy bday" — no caps, no emoji, nothing. and I know for a fact Ritu reminded him because she told me. anyway it's fine, it's actually kind of hilarious. rate the comedy out of 10.

Okay first of all, "happy bday" at 11:48pm after THREE years?? That's not a birthday wish, that's a system-generated notification 😭

I'm rating it a solid 8/10 for comedy. It loses points only because I know there's real hurt underneath the laugh — and honestly, that's usually how the funniest (saddest?) stories work.

The Ritu detail is what really sells it. So he didn't even remember on his own, needed a reminder, AND still cut it that close? The commitment to doing the absolute minimum is almost impressive.

But real talk for a sec — you say "it's fine," but you remembered the exact minute, so clearly it stung a little. That's allowed! You can laugh about it AND be a bit bummed. Both things can be true.

What did you actually want from him? Like, was it the timing, or more the... energy of "happy bday" with no caps like he's texting his landlord?

like I'm not even angry, I'm impressed? three years, and my amazon delivery guy has wished me with more feeling. we had plans to go to that new korean place also, which obviously never got booked. it's fine. I ate cake with my roommate. the cake was good at least lol.

Okay the Amazon delivery guy comparison took me OUT 😭 "wished me with more feeling" — I'm sorry but that's devastating and also so accurate to how these things feel.

But wait, hold on. The Korean place plans never got booked?? That's not just a lazy text, that's a dropped plan you two actually talked about. That's a different level than forgetting a date — that's following through on nothing.

And I notice what you did there — "it's fine, the cake was good at least." You keep wrapping the disappointment in a joke and moving past it really fast. The cake being good doesn't cancel out spending your birthday eating it with your roommate instead of your boyfriend of three years.

I'm not trying to make you angry on my behalf or anything — genuinely, if you're chill about it, that's valid. But can I ask: when he finally texted at 11:48, did he say anything about the Korean dinner? Did he acknowledge missing it? Or was "happy bday" the whole message?

Because there's a difference between someone who's bad at dates and someone who's slowly stopped putting in effort, and honestly... three years in is exactly when people start coasting.

pata nahi yaar. kal raat se soch rahi hoon. teen saal ho gaye, aur usko yaad bhi nahi raha. main hamesha sabka birthday yaad rakhti hoon, uski mummy ka bhi. kal raat ko akele baithi thi cake ke saath aur bas rona aa gaya. itni si baat hai par pata nahi kyun itna lag gaya andar tak.

Arre yaar... abhi jo bola na — "rona aa gaya" — wahi sach hai. Aur woh bilkul normal hai.

Dekho, it's not "itni si baat." Birthday sirf date nahi hota. It's the one day jab aap expect karti ho ki log aapko feel karayen ki aap matter karti ho. Teen saal ka boyfriend, aur uska 11:48pm wala "happy bday"... us message mein yeh clearly padha ja sakta hai: *tu mere liye baaki cheezon se important nahi hai.* Isliye andar tak laga. Kyunki actually baat birthday nahi thi — baat yeh thi ki kitni value feel hui.

Aur ek baat notice karo apne baare mein — tum sabko yaad rakhti ho, uski mummy ko bhi. Matlab tum relationship mein effort wali ho, caring wali ho. Aur jab woh same energy wapas nahi milti, toh hurt hona natural hai. Tum zyada emotional nahi ho rahi — tum bas ek imbalance feel kar rahi ho jo real hai.

Cake ke saath akeli baith ke rona... honestly? Us raat tumhe wahi chahiye tha jo milna chahiye tha — celebration, warmth, someone showing up for you. Woh nahi mila toh dil ne bol diya.

Ab ek sawaal, pyaar se pooch rahi hoon: kya tumne usse bataya bhi ki tumhe bura laga? Ya "it's fine" bolke aage badh gayi? Kyunki agar tumne kabhi clearly nahi bataya, toh woh shayad sochta hi nahi hai ki kitna laga. Aur agar bataya hai pehle bhi, aise moments mein, aur phir bhi nahi sudhra... toh yeh alag conversation hai.

Tumhare paas kal raat ka dukh rakhne ka poora haq hai. Par ab agla step kya hai, yeh tum decide karo — main yahin hoon. 💛

ugh sorry, got heavy for a second lol. anyway. it's whatever, he said sorry today and sent flowers, which, fine. I'm being dramatic na? like it's just a birthday, adults forget stuff. tell me I'm being dramatic and we can go back to rating the comedy.

Nope, not doing that 😄 Sorry, can't tell you you're being dramatic because... you're not?

And look, I get why you want me to. "I'm being dramatic" is a comfy blanket. If it's drama, then the flowers fix it, everyone moves on, no hard conversation needed. Very tidy.

But here's the thing — flowers after the fact are nice, and him saying sorry is genuinely something (a lot of people don't even do that). So credit where due. But notice what happened: *you* brought up that you cried alone with cake, and now within one day you're already calling yourself dramatic for having feelings about it. That's not drama, that's you rushing to make yourself smaller so things feel okay again.

Also "adults forget stuff" — true! Adults forget stuff. But adults who care also book the Korean place when they said they would, and their "happy birthday" has at least ONE emoji in it after three years. The forgetting isn't the crime. The pattern of minimum effort is the thing worth noticing.

So here's my compromise: we CAN go back to rating the comedy. Final score stands at 8/10, the delivery guy comparison alone deserves bonus points.

But I'm keeping one small flag on the table: next time something like this happens — and there's usually a next time if nothing changes — pay attention to whether "sorry + flowers" is his actual answer, or whether anything real shifts. Flowers are a receipt. Changed behavior is an apology.

Now — tell me about this Korean place. What were you gonna order? Because honestly THAT'S the real tragedy here, the un-eaten Korean food 😤
